content_sections.heading: About GBU
content_sections.text: Gujarat Biotechnology University is located at Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT city), Gandhinagar, and its letterhead names the Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat. These posts belong to the research project "Developing Multi-utility Seaweed Polysaccharide-Based Agri-inputs for Enhanced Crop Productivity and Sustainability". Dr. Nitin Trivedi and Dr. Neelam Kungwani are the project's PIs, and Dr. Gunjan Sharma is its Co-PI.

content_sections.heading: GBU Research Associate-I and Project Associate-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Minimum qualifications: Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree or having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Desirable qualifications: Prior research experience in biopolymer extraction, derivatization and their characterization Prior research experience in synthesis of superabsorbent composites/hydrogels, and in seed coating and its characterization Prior research experience in handling a biomass processing reactor and related assemblies, and in bioprocess engineering Prior research publications/patent in biopolymers, superabsorbent composites, hydrogels or seed coating Hands-on experience in operating a biomass processing reactor Proficiency in scientific writing and lab management Minimum qualifications: Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences MVSc or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent. Desirable qualifications: Experience working in agriculture and horticulture (field and pot trials) Experience with seedling growth parameters (root and shoot length, vigor index) Experience in lab management and administration Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted, and shortlisted candidates are informed through email regarding the interview process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The fellowship runs initially for 1 year and is extended to the next year, subject to satisfactory performance. The total project duration is 2 years. The post is purely temporary and co-terminates with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBU Research Associate-I and Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the GBU online application form . Complete the online application for the post you are eligible for. Submit it with your latest CV and other credentials on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply for Research Associate I without a Ph.D.?
faq.answer: Yes, if you have 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech, plus at least one research paper in an SCI journal.

faq.question: Q2. Can a B.Tech graduate apply for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: Yes. A bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent meets the minimum qualification for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What experience helps a Project Associate I applicant?
faq.answer: The notice lists field and pot trials in agriculture and horticulture, seedling growth parameters, and lab management and administration as desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Which research background suits the Research Associate I post?
faq.answer: Desirable areas include biopolymer extraction, superabsorbent composites or hydrogels, seed coating and biomass processing reactors. Publications or a patent in these fields are also desirable.

faq.question: Q5. On which date is the age limit counted?
faq.answer: Age is counted on the closing date of the advertisement, so the 35-year limit applies on that date.

faq.question: Q6. Who funds this project?
faq.answer: The Department of Biotechnology (DBT, GoI) funds the project at GBU.

faq.question: Q7. What must I submit with the application?
faq.answer: The Google form must be submitted with your latest CV and other credentials.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I send questions about the project?
faq.answer: Project queries can be sent to [email protected].
